The Beanblader.text: Be still. The bean has spoken.
I did not launch. I simply let go.
The stadium is calm. Like me.
Spin is a breath. I breathe deeply.
Effort is noise. Victory is silence.
One breath. One rip. One point.
I float. My opponent does not.

The Beyby.text: Bet you didn't see me coming!
Hood up, bey down, point in!
Catch me if you can! You can't!

The Breycist.text: Didn't even look. Didn't need to.
Was that a point? I wasn't watching.
Grazie. I'll be here all day.
Style points? I take all of them.
Too easy. Back to looking good.
Don't clap. Okay, you can clap.

The Buzzsaw.text: BACKFLIP LAUNCH! Did you see that?!
Physics said no. I said rip!
That launch had a triple twist!
I wrote the schedule AND that point!

The Cheatseeker.text: The rule book approves of me.
Rule one: I find the gaps.
Hmm. No rules broken. By me.
I read the rules. You should too.
Appendix B: I win this one.

The Fairy Dancer.text: A pirouette, a pixie, a point!
Float like a fairy, burst like one!

The Joyzerker.text: Yay! A point! RAAAGH! A POINT!
Hugs for all! BURSTS FOR ALL!
Joy level: max! Zerk level: MAX!
Aww, a point! GRRR, A POINT!

The Modsmith.text: A few screws loose? On purpose.
My bey has more mods than parts.
Data says I win. Data's right.

The Pugilist.text: Gloves on, bey out, point in!
Float like a bey, sting like a bey!
Who's next? I'm just warming up!
Did you feel that? I felt that!

The Stancemancer.text: Don't let the glasses fool you.
The water was calm. Then it hit.

The Torque Warden.text: You hit a wall. The wall was me.
The floor cracked. You didn't win.
I have not moved. You have.
Your spin ends where I begin.
Tip of the hat. Point to me.
That's all the effort you get.

The Underdogger.text: Raise the horn! Raise the score!
Told you. Never count me out!
From the bottom to the top!
A toast! To me! And that point!
Rock on, rip on, roll on!
Odds? I eat odds for breakfast.

The Beanblader|The Beyby.line: The bean waits. The baby rushes.
Too fast for your floaty beans!
The Beanblader|The Beyby.reply: The beans were not upset. Nor am I.

The Beanblader|The Beyby.line: Bet you can't meditate THAT away!

The Beanblader|The Breycist.line: You do not watch. I do not worry.

The Beanblader|The Breycist.reply: Cool is a type of calm, actually.

The Beanblader|The Breycist.line: Didn't look. Still beat the monk.
The Beanblader|The Breycist.reply: Your eyes were closed. So were mine.

The Beanblader|The Breycist.line: Nice robe. Mine has a zip.
The Beanblader|The Breycist.reply: My robe has inner peace. And pockets.

The Beanblader|The Buzzsaw.reply: Stillness can't do a double flip!

The Beanblader|The Buzzsaw.line: Feet on the ground... well, nearly.

The Beanblader|The Buzzsaw.reply: A fine flip. Breathe after it.
Every way up is fine with me.

The Beanblader|The Cheatseeker.reply: Page 9 says peace needs a referee.

The Beanblader|The Cheatseeker.line: The beans abide by every rule.
The Beanblader|The Cheatseeker.reply: Beans aren't in the rules. Yet.

The Beanblader|The Cheatseeker.line: Levitating? Let me check the rules.
The Beanblader|The Cheatseeker.reply: The rules do not mention floating.

The Beanblader|The Fairy Dancer.reply: Next time I'm bringing extra wings.

The Beanblader|The Fairy Dancer.line: Your pixie dust is in my beans.
The Beanblader|The Fairy Dancer.reply: Bean dust is in my wings too!

The Beanblader|The Fairy Dancer.line: A pirouette for the peaceful one!
The Beanblader|The Fairy Dancer.reply: I accept it with deep gratitude.
Beans do not spin. They wait.

The Beanblader|The Joyzerker.reply: My inner zerker says NO! Haha!
I have balance! Half joy, half RAGE!
Please do not shout at the beans.

The Beanblader|The Modsmith.reply: Hold on, I'm building one now.
Then why are you sweating, friend?

The Beanblader|The Pugilist.line: Peace in the face of punches.
The Beanblader|The Pugilist.reply: I'll punch the peace right back!

The Beanblader|The Stancemancer.line: A good stance. Floating is better.
The Beanblader|The Stancemancer.reply: You can't have stance without ground.

The Beanblader|The Torque Warden.line: Your beans are no match for torque.
The wall stands. The beans scatter.

The Beanblader|The Underdogger.reply: I'll take peace AND the next point!

The Beanblader|The Underdogger.line: Lower the horn. Find your calm.

The Beanblader|The Underdogger.reply: May your horn be ever full of juice.

The Beanblader|The Underdogger.line: Never count me out, bean man!
The Beanblader|The Underdogger.reply: I never count. I just breathe.

The Beyby|The Breycist.line: Looked away? I zoomed past you!
The Beyby|The Breycist.reply: I meant to let you past. Obviously.
Excuse me, this tracksuit is ironed.
Small fry, BIG bite! Next round!

The Beyby|The Breycist.line: Didn't look. Didn't have to, kid.
The Beyby|The Breycist.reply: Look next time! I'm right here!

The Beyby|The Buzzsaw.line: I can flip too! Kind of!
The Beyby|The Buzzsaw.reply: Kid, you're a natural! Do it again!

The Beyby|The Buzzsaw.line: Did you see how high I got?!
The Beyby|The Buzzsaw.reply: I saw your shoes! Way up there!
Baby leap beats you next time!

The Beyby|The Cheatseeker.line: Was that legal? Who cares! Point!
The Beyby|The Cheatseeker.reply: I care. I checked. It was legal.

The Beyby|The Cheatseeker.line: Your rule book is bigger than me!
The Beyby|The Cheatseeker.reply: And it says you must stand still!

The Beyby|The Fairy Dancer.line: A twirl too quick for the tot!

The Beyby|The Joyzerker.reply: Small and mighty? TINY AND RAGEY!

The Beyby|The Joyzerker.line: Aww, tiny bey! BURST TINY BEY!
The Beyby|The Joyzerker.reply: Can't burst what you can't catch!

The Beyby|The Modsmith.reply: Speed is a mod you can't buy.

The Beyby|The Modsmith.line: Calculated your speed. And beat it.
The Beyby|The Modsmith.reply: I'll get faster than your maths!

The Beyby|The Modsmith.line: My tracker clocked you. Too slow.

The Beyby|The Pugilist.line: That's how a big kid does it!
The Beyby|The Pugilist.reply: Wait till I grow! Next week!

The Beyby|The Stancemancer.line: Too quick to see you crouch!

The Beyby|The Torque Warden.reply: That wasn't a wobble. Was it?
I'll climb your wall! Zoom zoom!

The Beyby|The Torque Warden.line: The wall does not move for babies.

The Beyby|The Underdogger.line: Two underdogs! I win this one!
Never count out the big dog!
The Beyby|The Underdogger.reply: I can count to ten! Rematch!

The Breycist|The Buzzsaw.reply: Class is FINE. Flips are FUN!

The Breycist|The Buzzsaw.line: Did you flip? I wasn't looking.
The Breycist|The Buzzsaw.reply: You missed the best flip ever!

The Breycist|The Buzzsaw.line: Look at THIS one! Upside down!
The Breycist|The Buzzsaw.reply: Fine. I looked. It was alright.

The Breycist|The Buzzsaw.line: Even Mr Cool turned to watch!

The Breycist|The Cheatseeker.line: Rule book? I wrote the style guide.
The Breycist|The Cheatseeker.reply: Style guides aren't in the rules.

The Breycist|The Cheatseeker.line: Looking for a foul? Keep looking.

The Breycist|The Fairy Dancer.line: Even pixies stop to watch me.
A twirl you HAD to watch!
The Breycist|The Fairy Dancer.reply: Fine. One look. It was lovely.

The Breycist|The Fairy Dancer.line: Even the cool guy looked up!
The Breycist|The Fairy Dancer.reply: I'd rather look good. And I do.

The Breycist|The Joyzerker.line: Calm down. Watch how it's done.

The Breycist|The Joyzerker.reply: Nobody is too chill for the ZERK!

The Breycist|The Joyzerker.line: Yay! Wipe off that smirk! RAAH!

The Breycist|The Modsmith.line: Raw style beats a rewired bey.
The Breycist|The Modsmith.reply: You won't say that at version 48.

The Breycist|The Modsmith.line: Your smirk isn't in my data.

The Breycist|The Pugilist.reply: Then I'll punch twice as hard!

The Breycist|The Pugilist.line: Pow! NOW I've got your attention!
Knocked the cool right off you!
The Breycist|The Pugilist.reply: Cool grows back. Like my hair.

The Breycist|The Stancemancer.reply: Swagger is a stance. A poor one.

The Breycist|The Torque Warden.reply: Your hair moved. I did not.

The Breycist|The Torque Warden.line: You looked away. I did not.
The Breycist|The Torque Warden.reply: I looked back. It was worse.

The Breycist|The Underdogger.line: Raise a toast to the smooth one.
Look at this one, cool guy!

The Buzzsaw|The Cheatseeker.line: Find THAT in your rule book!

The Buzzsaw|The Cheatseeker.reply: You just made that rule up!
That flip was art! Art is legal!

The Buzzsaw|The Fairy Dancer.reply: A pirouette is a flip, sideways.

The Buzzsaw|The Fairy Dancer.line: Pixie dust? I flipped through it!

The Buzzsaw|The Fairy Dancer.reply: Chaos is just grace with more noise!
Next time I'll twirl AND twist!

The Buzzsaw|The Joyzerker.reply: Absurd! I LOVE IT! I HATE IT!

The Buzzsaw|The Joyzerker.line: Joy beats flips! RAGE BEATS ALL!
The Buzzsaw|The Joyzerker.reply: Hah! Best match of the day!

The Buzzsaw|The Modsmith.line: Calculated your flip. Then beat it.
My bey has a flip detector.
The Buzzsaw|The Modsmith.reply: Did it detect THAT one coming?

The Buzzsaw|The Pugilist.reply: Wait till I box a backflip!

The Buzzsaw|The Stancemancer.line: Feet on the floor. Point in the bag.
The Buzzsaw|The Stancemancer.reply: Feet on the floor? How boring!

The Buzzsaw|The Torque Warden.reply: Hmph. Walls can be climbed. Once.

The Buzzsaw|The Torque Warden.line: Spin the hat! Spin the bey!
Land on your feet. Then lose.
The Buzzsaw|The Torque Warden.reply: I landed on my HEAD. Still smiling!

The Buzzsaw|The Underdogger.line: Raise a horn to that flip!

The Cheatseeker|The Fairy Dancer.line: Rule 3: no glitter in the stadium.
The Cheatseeker|The Fairy Dancer.reply: That rule is not in any book!
Barely legal is still legal, love.

The Cheatseeker|The Joyzerker.line: Is rage in the rules? Hm.
The Cheatseeker|The Joyzerker.reply: RAGE IS IN MY HEART! Hehe.

The Cheatseeker|The Joyzerker.line: Point! FIND A RULE FOR THAT!

The Cheatseeker|The Pugilist.reply: I punched the AIR! Totally legal!

The Cheatseeker|The Pugilist.line: Did the book see THAT punch?
The Cheatseeker|The Pugilist.reply: It saw. It wrote it down.

The Cheatseeker|The Torque Warden.line: The book bends. I do not.

The Cheatseeker|The Underdogger.line: Rule 8: no horns in the stadium.
The Cheatseeker|The Underdogger.reply: This horn's a fan, not a player!
And I don't care about rules!

The Cheatseeker|The Underdogger.line: Never count me out! Not even you!
Find a rule against this toast!

The Fairy Dancer|The Joyzerker.line: A pirouette for both your faces!
The Fairy Dancer|The Joyzerker.reply: Happy face loved it! ANGRY FACE NO!

The Fairy Dancer|The Modsmith.reply: Magic is just tech I haven't built.

The Fairy Dancer|The Modsmith.line: Can your mods do a twirl?

The Fairy Dancer|The Modsmith.reply: My dust gets past every filter.

The Fairy Dancer|The Pugilist.line: Pow! Right in the pixie dust!

The Fairy Dancer|The Stancemancer.line: Flowing like water? I flow better.

The Fairy Dancer|The Stancemancer.reply: Grace is just posture with glitter.

The Fairy Dancer|The Stancemancer.line: Your spin wobbles. Mine never does.

The Fairy Dancer|The Torque Warden.reply: I let you. For the art.

The Fairy Dancer|The Torque Warden.line: Your wings will not move me.
The Fairy Dancer|The Torque Warden.reply: Wait till you see them flap.

The Fairy Dancer|The Underdogger.reply: And a toast for the fairy!

The Joyzerker|The Modsmith.line: I predicted both of your moods.

The Joyzerker|The Pugilist.reply: I only have happy ones! Pow!

The Joyzerker|The Stancemancer.reply: FIRE IS HAPPY! FIRE IS ANGRY!

The Joyzerker|The Torque Warden.line: Neither joy nor rage moves me.

The Joyzerker|The Underdogger.line: Joy and zerk beat the underdog!
The Joyzerker|The Underdogger.reply: Never count me out, double guy!
YAY FOR YOU! GRRR FOR ME!
METAL IS A MOOD! MY MOOD!

The Modsmith|The Torque Warden.line: Found the weak point in the wall.

The Modsmith|The Underdogger.line: Upgraded your horn. It's a launcher.
The Modsmith|The Underdogger.reply: Brilliant! Can it still hold juice?

The Modsmith|The Underdogger.line: Never count me out. Even you!

The Pugilist|The Stancemancer.reply: Hm. That was a fine punch.

The Pugilist|The Stancemancer.line: Your swing was wide. Mine was not.
The Pugilist|The Stancemancer.reply: Wide is where the fun is!

The Pugilist|The Torque Warden.line: You punched a wall. Wall wins.

The Stancemancer|The Torque Warden.reply: I moved. Do not get used to it.

The Stancemancer|The Torque Warden.line: Stance is good. Torque is better.
Your form is steady. Mine is stone.

The Stancemancer|The Underdogger.line: Heavy metal hits like a train!

The Torque Warden|The Underdogger.reply: Never count me out, big hat!
Then I'll toast twice as loud!

The Torque Warden|The Underdogger.line: A toast to the wall-breaker: me!
